AG-B3-1.title: NOT_MATERIAL EXCLUSION
AG-B3-1.disposition_verbatim: FIBIU-11 owns the FIBC-015 requirement that not_material outcomes do not contribute to the authoritative SROI numerator. The prior derived implementation surface was too narrow. Authorize the exact required sroi-calculation surface for this purpose. Rules: material: may contribute if all other methodology conditions permit. not_material: must never contribute to the authoritative numerator. unclassified: must not silently contribute to an authoritative persisted numerator. It remains visible in methodology/evidence state. FIBIU-19 remains owner of the composed approval/eligibility barrier and MATERIALITY_UNCLASSIFIED reason codes. Do NOT implement the FIBIU-19 composite gate here.

materialization.not_material: An active assignment whose outcome carries materiality_classification = 'not_material' is EXCLUDED from assignmentData before the engine runs; it is itemized as a SkippedAssignment with reason 'not_material' (retained in traceability with its exclusion reason, FIBC-015) in preview and in the persisted snapshot; it contributes exactly zero to grossSocialValue/netSocialValue/sroiRatio.
materialization.unclassified: An outcome with materiality_classification = NULL (pending) MAY contribute — FIBC-015 permits preliminary work while classification is pending and FIBIU-19 owns the approval block — but NEVER silently: every unclassified outcome that contributed is itemized in CalcResult.materialityUnclassifiedOutcomeIds, in the preview payload, and in the persisted snapshot (snapshotJson.materialityUnclassifiedOutcomeIds) so it remains visible in methodology state. Removing that itemization is a frozen mutation control (M-MAT-1b). MATERIALITY_UNCLASSIFIED as an eligibility rejection code is NOT emitted here (FIBIU-19).
materialization.no_stella_classification: No Stella path reads, writes, or infers materiality_classification; the classification action is a human server action only.

AG-B3-2.title: FIBC-016 NO-RATIO DOWNSTREAM SURFACE
AG-B3-2.disposition_verbatim: FIBC-016 is mandatory now and owned by FIBIU-12. If no outcome has defensible monetization: NO SROI ratio is emitted or persisted as a valid numeric ratio. Results reporting remains permitted. Downstream consumers may NOT fabricate a ratio from NULL/absence. At minimum inspect and, if still applicable, authorize: lib/portfolios/analytics.ts, lib/stella/context/build-composer-context.ts, app/(public)/verify/[hash]/page.tsx. Mechanically derive the exact remaining downstream consumers necessary to make the no-ratio state coherent across: Portfolio, Stella context, reporting, public verification, calculation results UI. Do NOT authorize broad lib/** or app/** wildcards. Freeze an exact literal/file-or-bounded-domain list in successor authority. Forbidden downstream behavior includes: NULL -> 0, NULL -> net/investment recomputation, NULL rendered as ':1', fabricated fallback SROI ratio, Stella receiving 0.0 when no ratio exists.

materialization.engine_rule: Defensible monetization at calculation time == at least one computed line item (approved live proxy AND approved bound version with USD value, positive quantity/value, outcome not not_material, filters known on the authoritative path). If the engine produces ZERO line items, CalcResult.sroiRatio = null, sroiRatioExact = null, noRatioReason = 'NO_DEFENSIBLE_MONETIZATION', fundersBreakdown = [] (no per-funder ratio is fabricated either), and sroi_calculation_runs.sroi_ratio is persisted as NULL with snapshotJson.sroiRatio = null and snapshotJson.noRatioReason set. totalInvestment/gross/net/lineItems/skippedAssignments/investments remain reported (results reporting permitted).
materialization.numeric_when_defensible: With >= 1 line item the ratio is emitted exactly as today (netSocialValue / totalInvestment, RATIO_DP = 6) — golden pins unchanged.
materialization.disposition_engine_consistency: recordOutcomeMonetizationDisposition refuses (named error, fail closed) a 'monetized' disposition for an outcome the run did not monetize (no line item for that outcome in that run) and a 'not_monetized' disposition for an outcome the run DID monetize; the human disposition attests and justifies the run's own exclusions — it can never fabricate coverage the immutable run does not carry.

AG-B3-4.title: NULL FILTER SEMANTICS
AG-B3-4.disposition_verbatim: calculateAndPersistSroiRun is part of the authoritative persisted path for FIBDB-010. Therefore: NULL / unknown != 0. Explicit 0 + justification: valid zero. NULL/unknown: must not be silently coerced to zero in a persisted/reportable authoritative result. A preliminary/non-authoritative preview may only use separate semantics if the product explicitly labels it preliminary and no persisted/reportable authoritative ratio is created from the coercion. For this B3 remediation: if a required filter value is unknown/null, preserve the unknown state and do not emit an authoritative numeric ratio based on an invented zero. FIBIU-19 still owns final approval eligibility composition.

materialization.engine_rule: runDeterministicCalc takes an explicit filterSemantics option with NO default: 'authoritative' (calculateAndPersistSroiRun) throws a named FILTER_VALUE_UNKNOWN error identifying the assignment and filter when any of deadweight/attribution/displacement/dropoff/duration is NULL/blank — no run row, no line item, no ratio is persisted from an invented zero; 'preliminary' (calculateSroiPreview, calculateSroiScenarios — both rendered under the existing 'Cálculo preliminar' label) keeps the legacy coercion but itemizes every coerced filter in CalcResult.preliminaryFilterAssumptions so the preview is never silent either.

AG-B3-6.title: APPROVED-RUN IMMUTABILITY
AG-B3-6.disposition_verbatim: FIBDB-009 'immutable once the run is approved' requires race-safe database enforcement. A service-only read status -> check -> update is insufficient because it has a TOCTOU window. Authorize a successor migration implementing DB-enforced refusal of UPDATE/DELETE after the associated run is approved. Do NOT edit sealed migration 0059. The mechanism may be trigger/policy/constraint-equivalent if mechanically proven correct. Before selecting the exact RLS remediation, PG-12 below is a HARD empirical gate.

required_content.update_policy: CREATE POLICY outcome_monetization_dispositions_update FOR UPDATE USING (organization_id = ANY(current_user_org_ids()) AND (current_user_role_in_org(organization_id) IN ('super_admin','organization_admin','impact_manager','analyst') OR current_user_is_super_admin())) WITH CHECK (same predicate) — the same analyst+ floor the 0059 INSERT policy uses; tenant isolation unchanged (org-scoped on both sides); guarded by DROP POLICY IF EXISTS.
required_content.delete_policy: NONE added — DELETE stays RLS-denied for the runtime (PG-13); the guard trigger below also refuses DELETE after approval at the DB level for any role.
required_content.approved_run_guard: SECURITY DEFINER trigger function (SET search_path = public) fired BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE FOR EACH ROW on outcome_monetization_dispositions: (1) takes pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(60, hashtext(calculation_run_id::text)); (2) refuses (RAISE ... ERRCODE insufficient_privilege) when EXISTS sroi_run_reviews WHERE calculation_run_id = <run> AND status = 'approved'; (3) on UPDATE refuses any change to id/organization_id/outcome_id/calculation_run_id/created_by/created_at (identity columns are immutable — a re-tenanting UPDATE is impossible).
required_content.approval_side_lock: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE FOR EACH ROW trigger on sroi_run_reviews: when NEW.status = 'approved' (INSERT, or UPDATE from a non-approved status) takes pg_advisory_xact_lock(60, hashtext(NEW.calculation_run_id::text)) (exclusive). Together with the shared lock above this closes the TOCTOU window: an approval in flight blocks every disposition write on that run until it commits, after which the guard's fresh READ COMMITTED snapshot sees the approved review and refuses; a disposition write in flight blocks the approval until it commits. Advisory locks need no table privilege, so the protocol does not depend on hosted GRANT posture (FOR UPDATE would require UPDATE on the append-only sroi_calculation_runs).
required_content.lock_key_namespace: int4 key1 = 60 (this migration's ordinal) in the two-int advisory-lock space — disjoint from the one-int8 space grounding_0005 uses (hashtextextended(evidence_id, 0)).
required_content.idempotency: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION + DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS + DROP POLICY IF EXISTS — reapply converges (PG-15).
